title: Funny song names: Plow Rain, Meatballs, Moonlight on the Shovel
summary: Laine lists the made-up titles his boys gave their pieces, such as Plow Rain, Meatballs and Little Bunch of Whiskers.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: In my ignorance. You can look it up in the Masonic, you know, the Masons have a book. And it tells you all that. You can go look in the old books, Papa. Papa, you were talking about at this political rally when you were 16 now, your songs did not have any names. No. Now, after that, when you played other jobs, what's the first song you can remember your band playing? Plow Rain. What's that? A song called Plow Rain. Plow Rain. Like Rains for a Horse? No, no. No. Plow Rain is like Pecan Candy.
The name of the call of the plane. Oh, oh. The name of the piece we played. We give it a name. Yeah. Stuff that we bring up ourselves. I see.
Yeah. Plow Rain. Plow Rain. Meatballs. And Sunlight. Moonlight on the Shovel. And all that sort of funny names.
Well, who made up those names? Did you make up those names? Yeah, the boy did. With me. Is that right?
Yeah. Not only me myself. Uh-uh.
Plow Rain's Meatball. Yeah. Moonlight on the Shovel. Can you remember any more? No, I can't remember.
But there's lots of them we played, and I can't remember all of them.
Little Bunch of Whiskers on a Young Man Grew.
Tell him. Little Bunch of Whiskers on a Young Man Grew.
